issues.text: Run 1 "Main <&> "x"": the manual recommends the M1DBH close to the control (the ELK-W018B ribbon cable is for under 24 inches). The feed cable here is 7.5 ft: use a dedicated 4-wire cable, 22 AWG or heavier.

Run 1 "Main <&> "x"", hub 2: home run "B1" has 2 devices. A home run goes to one device location; devices at the same location share its terminals. Devices at different places need their own home runs.
Run 1 "Main <&> "x"": hubs are linked in one straight daisy chain with a crossover cable. Never connect hubs as spokes off one hub.
No device currents entered, so the power load was not checked. The +12V keypad output of the control is protected at 1.25 A; the hub adds 30 mA, plus 20 mA per branch for the M1DBHR.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): INSTALL it. With one run, the control end is the second of the two termination points.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1: Main <&> "x"
items: Connect hub 1 to the control's +12V, DATA A, DATA B and NEG terminals with a dedicated 4-wire cable, 22 AWG minimum (7.5 ft). The optional ELK-W018B ribbon cable can be used if the hub is under 24 inches from the board.
Hub 1, J1: home run "A1" (20 ft) to Keypad (address 1).
Hub 1, J2: home run "A2" (20 ft) to Keypad (address 2).
Hub 1, J3: home run "A3" (20 ft) to Keypad (address 3).
Hub 1, J4: crossover cable (orange and green pairs swapped) to J1 of hub 2. No terminating plug on this hub.
Hub 2, J1: home run "B1" (20 ft) to M1XIN (address 3) + M1XOVR (address 1).
Hub 2, J2: insert the RJ45 terminating plug (120 Ω, supplied). It is the only termination on the hub side. Do not terminate any device.
Fill jacks from J1 upward without skipping one. Use continuous CAT5/6 from hub to device, no splices and no other cable type. Wire to the device terminals with the T568A colours (below).

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: M1XIN (address 3): zones 33-48; S1 on, S2 on, S3 off, S4 off
After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
